name: Somadina Forsberg-Ofosu
role: Personnel recovery and hostile extraction — extraction specialist
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Somadina Forsberg-Ofosu is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 38, the augmentation scarring around his temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — geneware muscle density treatment — looks natural, hits like chrome — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He grew up in the Narrows, where the walls are so close together you learn to fight in confined spaces or you learn to lose. He works as a extraction specialist out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Somadina Forsberg-Ofosu is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who he burned last.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Compartmentalization — work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Somadina Forsberg-Ofosu sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "We go in, we get the asset, we leave. Everything else is improvisation."
"The extraction window is four minutes. I've done it in three."
"I don't rescue people. I relocate them aggressively."

story_hooks: A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Somadina Forsberg-Ofosu owes a personal debt to
Somadina Forsberg-Ofosu intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
Someone is impersonating Somadina Forsberg-Ofosu on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
narrative_function: Somadina Forsberg-Ofosu functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Geneware muscle density treatment — looks natural, hits like chrome. Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture

physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible muscular definition — wiry strength rather than bulk. The geneware muscle density treatment creates an almost unnaturally efficient frame, all compact power and minimal fat. His shoulders are broad but not wide; his limbs are long and precise.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, utilitarian. He doesn't style it — he cuts it short to reduce variables.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint chromatic iridescence around the pupils — subtle sign of the dermal camouflage system
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with warm undertones, a blended phenotype reflecting his mixed heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sharp facial features — high cheekbones, angular jaw, direct gaze. His face is weathered but not aged; sleep deprivation and stress have carved fine lines around his eyes. His skin shows the pale, luminous quality of someone who lives nocturnally, though darker-skinned than full nocturnal pallor would suggest.
distinguishing_marks: Augmentation scarring around both temples in faint straight lines where neural interface ports were installed — visible but faded
Augmentation scarring along the jawline on both sides where geneware muscle density treatment was layered into the facial structure — surgical precision but no attempt at cosmetic smoothing
A thin white scar across his left knuckle — old knife work, probably from the Narrows
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geneware muscle density treatment visible as subtle chrome sheen under the skin when he moves — tendons and muscle fibers catch light unnaturally during exertion. The chromatic skin pigment cells of his dermal camouflage create occasional iridescent shifts across his forearms and neck under certain lighting, particularly blue or ultraviolet. No external chrome limbs; all augmentations are integrated.
physical_description.posture_movement: He moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, every gesture purposeful. His default stance is loose but alert, weight distributed for immediate action. He doesn't fidget or relax into furniture; even sitting, there's coiled tension in his frame. His gaze is tracking, always reading the room. He speaks quietly and rarely, forcing others to lean in or strain to listen — a power dynamic he controls.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian-technical aesthetic. Black tactical pants with reinforced seams and cargo pockets, fitted but not tight. Matte-finish synthetic shirt, usually dark gray or charcoal, with minimal branding — function over identity. A worn composite-weave jacket in slate gray with asymmetrical zipper placements and internal pockets for gear. Lightweight boots with non-reflective soles, broken in but maintained. No jewelry, no corporate logos, no status symbols. Everything is chosen for durability, silence, and low visibility. His clothes are clean but not new; they show professional wear, not poverty.

image_prompt: A lean, angular Black-Scandinavian male in his late 30s, sharp facial features with graying temples, standing in moody nocturnal lighting. Dark tactical clothing — charcoal synthetic shirt, slate gray composite jacket, black reinforced pants. Subtle iridescent shimmer visible on forearms and neck from dermal camouflage augmentations. Faint augmentation scarring visible at temples and jawline. Intense, calculating dark eyes with faint chromatic iridescence. Nocturnal pallor on warm brown skin. Standing in three-quarter pose in a half-ruined urban corridor with exposed concrete and shadows, blue and amber sodium lighting casting long shadows.
